$comment: JSON Schema for out/temporal_events.json: the super-node event log across consecutive snapshots (T3). Event types: birth (0->1), death (1->0), merge (>=2->1), split (1->>=2); continue / growth / change keep the id (members identical / strict superset / any other change). Arity, reference, order, lineage-completeness and membership rules are checked by validate.py.

from_snapshot.description: null only for births in the first snapshot
